BELLKEEPER-CHIME.title: Chime
BELLKEEPER-CHIME.description: Collective term for [gold]Guard[/gold], [gold]Peal[/gold], [gold]Vanguard[/gold], [gold]Gather Qi[/gold], [gold]Echo Tune[/gold], and [gold]Fervor[/gold]. Triggers at the start of your next turn (or when you [gold]Toll[/gold]), then removed.
BELLKEEPER-TOLL.title: Toll
BELLKEEPER-TOLL.description: Immediately trigger and remove all of your [gold]Chime[/gold] and [gold]Dissonance[/gold] statuses.
BELLKEEPER-SUSTAIN.title: Sustain
BELLKEEPER-SUSTAIN.description: Whenever your [gold]Chime[/gold] statuses trigger and would be removed, consume 1 stack to retain 50% of those triggered [gold]Chime[/gold] stacks.
BELLKEEPER-RESONANCE.title: Harmonic
BELLKEEPER-RESONANCE.description: Triggers a bonus effect if you currently have at least the specified number of distinct [gold]Chime[/gold] types.
BELLKEEPER-SINK.title: Sink
BELLKEEPER-SINK.description: Put up to the specified number of cards from your Hand onto the bottom of your Draw Pile in order.
BELLKEEPER-GUARD.title: Guard
BELLKEEPER-GUARD.description: A [gold]Chime[/gold]. At the start of your next turn (or when you [gold]Toll[/gold]), gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to its stacks, then remove it.
BELLKEEPER-PEAL.title: Peal
BELLKEEPER-PEAL.description: A [gold]Chime[/gold]. At the start of your next turn (or when you [gold]Toll[/gold]), deal damage equal to its stacks to ALL enemies, then remove it.
BELLKEEPER-MUTE.title: Mute
BELLKEEPER-MUTE.description: A [gold]Dissonance[/gold]. After drawing at the start of your next turn (or when you [gold]Toll[/gold]), choose and discard cards from your Hand equal to its stacks, then remove it.
BELLKEEPER-BURDEN.title: Burden
BELLKEEPER-BURDEN.description: A [gold]Dissonance[/gold]. After gaining Energy at the start of your next turn (or when you [gold]Toll[/gold]), lose Energy equal to its stacks, then remove it.
BELLKEEPER-DREDGE.title: Dredge
BELLKEEPER-DREDGE.description: Reduce the cost of the bottom specified number of cards in your Draw Pile by 1 until played.
BELLKEEPER-DRAW_BOTTOM.title: Bottom-Draw
BELLKEEPER-DRAW_BOTTOM.description: Draw the specified number of cards from the bottom of your Draw Pile.
BELLKEEPER-DISSONANCE.title: Dissonance
BELLKEEPER-DISSONANCE.description: Collective term for [gold]Mute[/gold], [gold]Burden[/gold], [gold]Tremor[/gold], and [gold]Offbeat[/gold]. Triggers at the start of your next turn (or when you [gold]Toll[/gold]), then removed.
BELLKEEPER-VANGUARD.title: Vanguard
BELLKEEPER-VANGUARD.description: A [gold]Chime[/gold]. At the start of your next turn (or when you [gold]Toll[/gold]), draw cards equal to its stacks, then remove it.
BELLKEEPER-GATHER_QI.title: Gather Qi
BELLKEEPER-GATHER_QI.description: A [gold]Chime[/gold]. After gaining Energy at the start of your next turn (or when you [gold]Toll[/gold]), gain Energy equal to its stacks, then remove it.
BELLKEEPER-ECHO_TUNE.title: Echo Tune
BELLKEEPER-ECHO_TUNE.description: A [gold]Chime[/gold]. At the start of your next turn (or when you [gold]Toll[/gold]), [gold]Bottom-Draw 1[/gold] per stack and reduce its cost by 1 this turn, then remove it.
BELLKEEPER-FERVOR.title: Fervor
BELLKEEPER-FERVOR.description: A [gold]Chime[/gold]. At the start of your next turn (or when you [gold]Toll[/gold]), gain [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn equal to its stacks, then remove it.
BELLKEEPER-TREMOR.title: Tremor
BELLKEEPER-TREMOR.description: A [gold]Dissonance[/gold]. At the start of your next turn (or when you [gold]Toll[/gold]), take 2 blockable damage per stack, then remove it.
BELLKEEPER-OFFBEAT.title: Offbeat
BELLKEEPER-OFFBEAT.description: A [gold]Dissonance[/gold]. After drawing at the start of your next turn (or when you [gold]Toll[/gold]), choose cards from your Hand equal to its stacks to put on top of your Draw Pile, then remove it.
